identitySignals: Agenda name 'Toshiba America Business Solutions' matches the company's own site, which gives the legal name 'Toshiba America Business Solutions, Inc.' (business.toshiba.com contact page)

Agenda item is a piggyback agreement for 'Digital Workspace Solutions'; a public Alameda County agenda shows Region 4 Education Service Center contract R241202 (OMNIA Partners RFP 24-12, Digital Workspace Solutions) was awarded to Toshiba America Business Solutions, Inc. dba Toshiba Business Solutions
Company sells print, document and digital workspace technology and lists education as an industry, matching OUSD's 'Technology' category
research.notes: Identity also corroborated by the Alameda County Board agenda (Dec 9, 2025) describing Region 4 contract R241202 for Digital Workspace Solutions awarded to Toshiba America Business Solutions, Inc. dba Toshiba Business Solutions. No general email found; registry IDs not looked up.

profile.summary: Toshiba America Business Solutions is a company that sells print and digital products and services for offices and other organizations. Its offerings include multifunction printers, scanners, wide format printers and digital signage, along with managed print services, document management and cloud solutions. It serves industries such as healthcare, government and education.
